Karnataka, Oil Firms Clash Over Ethanol in Petrol

Karnataka government officials and oil marketing companies (OMCs) are in disagreement regarding the ethanol content in petrol. The state government claims that the actual ethanol blend in petrol is lower than the mandated E20 (20% ethanol blend). Auto industry executives have called for independent testing of ethanol content to resolve the dispute.
